label: early-episode D1 after a rewarded common a1->S1 trial (a1 win streak)
explanation: Fires only at D1 with reward input 1, only when the rewarded previous trial was a1 with a common transition to S1 (prev_action==2 or rare-rewarded gives ~0 activity), and only early in the episode (ep_trials ~3-21; zero after trial 30). On the window first trial prev_action is unknown, so the agent upcoming choice (action==1, its own computed choice, not a random outcome) is used as a proxy there; that is the only FUTURE variable. Magnitude ramps up over consecutive rewarded a1->S1 trials and decays with episode time and after an unrewarded trial; 93% of mass is in episodes that start with S1 good (start_high, hidden), i.e. agents with a long a1 win streak since episode start. Never fires at GO or D2, on unrewarded D1, or after a2 choices. Dev F1 0.74, mass recall 0.99; precision ~0.6 limited because it requires a sustained streak, not just one win.
